content.text:
=== getent various ===
auth.localhost -> NO RESOLVE
localhost -> 127.0.0.1       localhost
foo.localhost -> NO RESOLVE
=== resolv.conf ===
nameserver 169.254.1.1
nameserver 192.168.127.1
=== dns servers ===
nameserver 169.254.1.1
nameserver 192.168.127.1

observation.command: echo "=== getent various ==="; for h in auth.localhost localhost foo.localhost; do printf "%s -> " "$h"; getent hosts "$h" || echo "NO RESOLVE"; done; echo "=== resolv.conf ==="; cat /etc/resolv.conf; echo "=== dns servers ==="; cat /etc/resolv.conf | grep nameserver
